messages:
emma: heads-up — discovered a token-delta cascade from a delayed ingestion window (03/14 02:00–03:20 UTC). two customers got negative balances then were auto-credited. need someone to own invoice corrections + timeline. any volunteers?
raj: can you paste the query you ran to find affected accounts?
olivia: repeating pattern: saw similar lag back in feb where delayed batches applied in wrong order. probable root = kafka replays + dedupe bug.
emma: query below (run against analytics-prod):
```sql
SELECT customer_id, sum(tokens_delta) AS net_delta, min(event_ts) AS first_seen
FROM token_events
WHERE event_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-14T02:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-14T03:30:00Z'
  AND source = 'ingest_batch'
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING abs(sum(tokens_delta)) > 10000;
```
matt: i'll take ownership of invoice corrections and the customer comms. ETA for initial corrections run tomorrow EOD PT unless blockers. tagging @finance_ops for approval. :raised_hands:
finance_ops: thanks matt — please provide a small test run plan and rollback steps. we need audit lines for every correction. also cc billing-bot for ticketing.
billing-bot: Created ticket FIN-3821 for invoice corrections; priority: P2; assignee: matt.
raj: for the root cause remediation: happy to pair with eng-ml to lock down replay dedupe. propose a two-week fix window: week1 hotfix to improve ordering for ingestion; week2 more robust dedupe and tests.
olivia: agree with raj. also recommend we add a recurring check that flags unusually large token deltas per customer per 1h window (alerts -> finance channel).
emma: action items from thread: 1) matt — owner for invoice corrections + customer comms (ticket FIN-3821). 2) raj + eng-ml — root cause hotfix (owner raj). 3) olivia — implement 1h delta alert (owner olivia). 4) finance_ops — approvals + audit template. 5) emma — postmortem doc and rollout checklist. please reply with ETA for your item so i can update remediation tracker.
matt: ETA for initial corrections run: 2026-03-15 23:00 PT (will run on staging test first 3 accounts). full run ETA if staging looks good: 2026-03-16 02:00 PT. will add audit csv and PR referencing FIN-3821.
raj: hotfix branch targeted for 2026-03-22 deploy to canary; full rollout 2026-03-29 if tests pass.
olivia: 1h-delta alert rule PR by 2026-03-18. will include alert thresholds and oncall playbook.
finance_ops: approval for correction plan granted, but require sign-off on customer email copy before send. emma, can you draft the comms?
emma: drafted comms in the doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/fin/FIN-3821-comms (outline only) — will post full copy by 2026-03-15 16:00 PT.
matt: noted — will not send anything until finance_ops signs off.
raj: quick note — this is possibly part of a recurring class of incidents. i'll start a short retrospective thread on recurring ingestion replays to surface other similar incidents.
olivia: adding monitoring checkpoints to the postmortem will help track recurrence. +1 to retrospective.
emma: ok closing the thread for now — i'll update the postmortem follow-up board with these owners and ETAs. ping me if your ETA changes. :white_check_mark:
